aop_peer.scope: Stopped reference AOP peer state and supported-command consumption
aop_peer.reason: Connected reference peer consumed a supported command; IPCC notifications exist and no completion notification is pending

noc_qos_observer.scope: Stopped raw NoC QoS QOM observations; source-correlated DT comparisons
noc_qos_observer.interpretation: Raw configuration only. A matching nonzero word demonstrates stored guest programming; it does not establish traffic, bandwidth enforcement, SBM, power readiness or full boot. Deferred IPA need not match its eventual DT policy.

smmuv500_observer.scope: Stopped raw apps SMMUv500 QOM observation only
smmuv500_observer.interpretation: Reference model identity and raw device state only. Zero requests do not prove a native TBU probe or DMA test; native progress requires separate kernel-log evidence. Version and delays are declared reference assumptions, and firmware stream/context handoff remains unknown.

tsens24xx_observer.scope: Stopped raw TSENS24xx QOM state and explicit reference inputs
tsens24xx_observer.interpretation: Sampling counters, captured inputs, VALID and vendor TRDY are raw digital-reference observations. The boot mask, 25 C environment and 1 ms period are explicit model choices, not measured tablet state or analog calibration. DT thermal references establish consumer channels only; kernel logs independently establish native probe progress. IRQ metadata records DT wiring, not a native interrupt-delivery test.

cpufreq_hw_observer.scope: Stopped CPUFreq EPSS reference identity and raw QOM state
cpufreq_hw_observer.interpretation: This is a stopped raw QOM snapshot, not a CPUFreq probe, policy, userspace, frequency-transition or interrupt-delivery verdict. The four all-XO LUT states, voltage words, limit input, always-clocked per-core counters and edge-latched IRQ are declared reference policies, not measured tablet firmware or analog behavior. A single counter value does not prove progress, and a nonzero requested index does not identify its writer. The alternate GPLL0 input is reported but no row in this profile uses src=0. DT SPI/INTID fields describe wiring only. Native kernel progress must be assessed separately from printk and explicit userspace evidence.

devfreq_fw_observer.scope: Stopped firmware-devfreq reference identity and raw request QOM state
devfreq_fw_observer.interpretation: Complete means the stopped raw QOM snapshot matches this explicit reference identity, synthetic nominal LUT and stored PERF request. The firmware-enabled boolean describes the selected reference handoff; it does not establish firmware execution. The nominal rates do not establish applied cache frequency. The four DT voter children are Linux software consumers of one parent request, not four hardware banks. An unchanged boot request or a different request identifies neither a successful driver probe nor its writer. Kernel progress and userspace execution require separate printk and userspace evidence.

noc_sbm_observer.scope: Stopped config NoC SBM reference identity and handshake state
noc_sbm_observer.reference_policy: Connected cold/reset state and 1000 ns virtual delay
noc_sbm_observer.interpretation: Complete means this stopped raw QOM snapshot matches the explicit reference geometry, identity and state invariants. Eight ports have independent deadlines scheduled by one QEMU virtual timer. Remaining zero with a pending bit is legal before that timer is dispatched. The observer neither advances virtual time nor completes a response. Accepted write counters and last masks are model diagnostics since reset, not physical registers or per-client success records. A clear write while already connected is idempotent. Settled reference bits do not prove real traffic drain, physical gating, successful driver probe or camera/display/venus execution. Kernel progress, userspace and Android boot require separate evidence.

rpmh_wait_observer.scope: Stopped RPMh WAIT reserved-bit reference-policy diagnostics
rpmh_wait_observer.reference_policy: Explicit idle WAIT writes store low16 and ignore high16; strict is the default
rpmh_wait_observer.interpretation: This is a stopped, double-read QOM observation of a declared reference policy. The count records accepted high-bit WAIT writes since reset, not completed TCS commands, interrupts or successful driver probes. The last raw word is diagnostic history; later guest writes may have replaced the current WAIT. A zero count can be a valid unused policy. No physical reserved-bit behavior or Android success is inferred.
